results.title: Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso resume dialogue with ECOWAS regional bloc - France 24
results.snippet:
Issued on:

Share

Three junta-ruled Sahel states – Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso – on Saturday resumed dialogue with the ECOWAS regional bloc, which they withdrew from more than 18 months ago. They agreed to work towards a “framework agreement” on cooperation. FRANCE 24’s regional correspondent Harold Girard tells us more.

results.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years - myMotherLode.com
results.snippet:
Last April, the countries of the Alliance of Sahel States — Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso — recalled their ambassadors from Algeria following an incident in which a Malian drone was shot down by Algeria’s army near the border.

Algeria’s foreign ministry also condemned the 2023 coup which brought Niger’s junta leader Tchiani to power.
